title: Derived-category stalk pullback comparison with representative formula
statement: Let f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S and g':X'→X form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], and choose derived categories of their module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category]. At z∈X', let R,A,B,C and ρ:A→A⊗_R B→C be the actual stalk rings and maps [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Suppose L:D(A)→D(C), ε:Qh∘L→ρ_*∘Qh is a universal left-derived pair for ordinary scalar extension. There is a natural isomorphism j:stalk_{g'z}∘L≅L(g')*∘stalk_z, with exact derived stalks [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. For each K-flat sheaf complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex] with invertible recorded pullback counit, L of the inverse exact-stalk localization factor followed by j at Q(P) equals the scalar-extension counit, including the Q-to-Qh and underived homotopy factors, followed by Q of the specified tensorStalkIso, the inverse new exact-stalk localization factor and derived stalk of the inverse pullback counit. This is an equality of derived morphisms before homology, not an assertion of existence of L or of invertibility of ε at stalk complexes.

proof.text: Obtain a natural comparison satisfying the exact K-flat representative equation from the construction lemma.
Apply the invertibility lemma to this transformation and equation. Bundle it with asIso; asIso.hom is the original transformation, so its representative equation is unchanged.

theorem exists_stalkDerivedExtensionComparisonIso (z : X') :
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (A g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (C z))
    ∀ (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (A g' z)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (C z)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
          ((algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z)).comp
            (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z)))).mapHomotopyCategory
              (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} (A g' z)) (.up ℤ))),
    ∃ j : comparisonDerivedStalk X (g' z) ⋙ L ≅
        derivedPullback g' ⋙ comparisonDerivedStalk X' z,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))),
        L.map ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (g' z)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app P) ≫
            j.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) =
          L.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.map
              (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
                ((algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z)).comp
                  (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z)))).mapHomotopyCategoryFactors
                  (.up ℤ)).hom.app
                (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso (ModuleCat.{u} (C z))).hom.app
              (tensorComplex f f' g g' sq z P) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z P).hom ≫
            (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
                (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
            (comparisonDerivedStalk X' z).map
              (inv ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
